title: RainbowRibbon
tagline: After the rain, the sky was clear, the rainbow appeared in the sky at this moment, and its soft body stretched out like a magnificent ribbon.
description: The time is to transform a person's immaturity into old age, and ignorance into understanding, just like the endless sunshine and rainbow after the darkness. When I was little, I liked all kinds of colors, and whenever I was sad, the rainbow band made me happy and calm. I hope my works can bring hope and good vision to people.
how_its_made: Figma. I did this by myself. I don't have any programming language skills, so I tried to learn figma and edited it according to the material on the Internet. I found ETHGlobal by chance, and I thought it was very interesting. I just regard the RainbowRibbon as a symbol, and a landmark of growth, I am trying to learn python and to put it on opensea.
